column1: # Nucleotides conserved across tRNAs, per Biela et al. 2023, used to check that
# a Sprinzl label lands on the base that position is known to carry.
# min_fraction is set below the value measured on data/cyto/euk_gtrnadb.fa (531
# sequences) so ordinary variation does not fail the suite. A drop past it means
# labels shifted, not that biology changed.
# Positions 19 and 21 are left out. Both are symptoms of one defect: in the
# D-loop the pooled labeler spends its deletion on 21 rather than 17, so the
# conserved GG pair lands on 17-18 instead of 18-19. Measured G19 0.26, A21 0.79
# with 134 of 531 sequences carrying no 21 at all. Restore both rows once the
# D-loop is anchored on the GG pair.
# Positions 74-76 are left out: the CCA end is not part of what sprinx labels.
